title: Nemotron PII Japan: プライバシー保護に向けた日本語PIIオープンデータ
gist: NVIDIA released Nemotron PII Japan, a CC BY 4.0 open dataset of 100,000 synthetic Japanese business documents across 8 domains and 43 document types with 56 PII entity types and 810,703 span annotations, generated via NeMo Data Designer with values fixed before LLM writing. Fine-tuning GLiNER multi-v2.1 on it lifted external Sumi benchmark micro F1 from 13.41% to 73.80% (in-template) and 8.13% to 65.30% (out-of-distribution).

themes.theme: Nemotron PII Japan dataset release and specs

insights.claim: NVIDIA released Nemotron PII Japan, an open dataset of 100,000 synthetic Japanese business documents with PII position and type annotations, covering 8 domains (medical, finance, government, employment, education, legal, telecom/IT, e-commerce) and 43 document types.
insights.speaker: Masaya Ogushi
insights.so_what: NVIDIA is seeding localized enterprise-AI safety infrastructure for Japan, a market where data-privacy constraints gate LLM adoption.
insights.quote: 医療、金融、行政、雇用、教育、法務、通信・IT、ECの8領域・43文書種を収録。
insights.locator: オープンデータとしての特徴

insights.claim: The Nemotron PII Japan dataset defines 56 PII entity types, including My Number (Japan's national ID), bank account numbers, and separate labels for medical institution, educational institution, and public body names.
insights.speaker: Masaya Ogushi
insights.so_what: Fine-grained, Japan-specific label taxonomy raises the bar for PII-detection vendors targeting Japanese enterprises.
insights.locator: オープンデータとしての特徴

insights.claim: The Nemotron PII Japan corpus totals 34,737,684 tokens (about 347 tokens per document, measured with the NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 9B v2 Japanese tokenizer) and contains 810,703 PII span annotations, about 8.11 per document.
insights.speaker: Masaya Ogushi
insights.so_what: Short, densely annotated documents suit training span-extraction models rather than long-context evaluation.
insights.locator: オープンデータとしての特徴

insights.claim: Nemotron PII Japan is released under CC BY 4.0, permitting both commercial and non-commercial use, as a single data.parquet file without a fixed train/test split.
insights.speaker: Masaya Ogushi
insights.so_what: Commercially usable license lowers cost for startups and SIs building Japanese PII-masking products.
insights.quote: CC BY 4.0 ライセンスに基づき、商用・非商用を問わず利用可能
insights.locator: オープンデータとしての特徴

themes.theme: Why Japanese PII masking needs contextual data

insights.claim: Japanese business-document AI must protect PII while preserving meaning, because the same name can play different roles (patient, doctor, applicant, staff) and addresses and dates (e.g., Japanese imperial-era dates) vary in notation, so evaluation must capture both missed leaks and over-masking that destroys useful information.
insights.speaker: Masaya Ogushi
insights.so_what: Masking quality, not just recall, determines whether regulated Japanese firms can safely route documents to external LLMs.
insights.quote: 見逃しによる漏えいと、過剰なマスキングによる情報の欠落の両方を評価するため、文脈を備えた日本語のオープンデータが役立ちます。
insights.locator: 日本のプライバシー保護に向けたオープンデータ

insights.claim: A key target use case is a Japanese financial institution summarizing loan-screening documents with an external LLM while masking birth dates, full addresses, and repayment account details but retaining loan purpose and screening rationale.
insights.speaker: Masaya Ogushi
insights.so_what: Signals demand for pre-LLM redaction gateways in Japanese banking, a niche for privacy middleware vendors.
insights.quote: 日本の金融機関がローン審査書類を外部LLMで要約する場合
insights.locator: 日本のプライバシー保護に向けたオープンデータ

insights.claim: Business documents containing real personal data are hard to share or reuse and therefore hard to use as common public benchmarks; synthetic PII lets developers compare methods under identical conditions, though synthetic results alone cannot guarantee production performance.
insights.speaker: Masaya Ogushi
insights.so_what: Synthetic benchmarks shift the bottleneck in privacy AI from data access to real-world validation.
insights.quote: 一方、合成データでの結果だけで実運用の性能は保証できません。

themes.theme: Generation pipeline: fix values first, let LLM write prose

insights.claim: The dataset is generated with NVIDIA's NeMo Data Designer, where PII and business values are decided before text generation and passed to the LLM as placeholders (e.g., __JP_PII_EMAIL_1__, __JP_PLAN_MONTHLY_REPAYMENT__), then substituted afterward and checked for consistency with the body text.
insights.speaker: Masaya Ogushi
insights.so_what: A reusable recipe for label-accurate synthetic data that avoids relying on LLM self-checks, relevant to any synthetic-data tooling business.
insights.quote: LLMの出力や自己点検だけに頼らず、人物・PII・業務上の値を先に決め、生成後に本文と照合します。
insights.locator: 生成パイプライン: 合成値を確定してから文章を書く

insights.claim: For documents that require arithmetic, a Data Designer Plugins component called CalculationPlan pre-computes results (e.g., a 137,653 yen monthly repayment from a 14.96 million yen loan at 2% over 10 years) and validates them with Pydantic schemas, so the LLM is never asked to calculate.
insights.speaker: Masaya Ogushi
insights.so_what: Shows NVIDIA's pattern of separating deterministic computation from LLM prose to get numerically correct synthetic data.
insights.quote: LLMへは計算を依頼せず、次のように結果を入れるplaceholderを渡します。
insights.locator: CalculationPlan: 返済額を事前に計算して説明文を作る

insights.claim: Person attributes in the generated documents come from NVIDIA's synthetic persona dataset Nemotron Personas Japan via DataDesigner's Person Sampler, combined with catalogs of companies, banks, document themes and medical scenarios that are type- and duplicate-checked before use.
insights.speaker: Masaya Ogushi
insights.so_what: NVIDIA is building a stack of interlocking Japan-specific synthetic datasets, deepening ecosystem lock-in around Nemotron/NeMo tools.
insights.quote: 人物カタログの基盤には、NVIDIAの合成ペルソナデータセットNemotron Personas Japanを使用しています。
insights.locator: カタログ: 文書に使う素材と関連情報を準備する

insights.claim: No real customer or patient information was collected; documents were built from synthetic personas, synthetic PII and business catalogs, with unintended inclusion of real information and label errors treated as post-generation check items.
insights.speaker: Masaya Ogushi
insights.so_what: Privacy-by-design provenance reduces legal risk for enterprises adopting the dataset.
insights.quote: 実際の顧客・患者情報を集めず、合成ペルソナ、合成PII、業務カタログを組み合わせて文書を生成しています。
insights.locator: プライバシーを保護した設計

themes.theme: GLiNER fine-tune results on external benchmarks

insights.claim: Fine-tuning urchade/gliner_multi-v2.1 on 95,000 Nemotron PII Japan documents with 56 labels raised exact-match micro F1 on the external Sumi test set (2,000 docs) from 13.41% to 73.80%, a +60.39 pp gain.
insights.speaker: Masaya Ogushi
insights.so_what: A small open NER model gains roughly 60 points from domain data, showing data rather than model scale drives Japanese PII performance.
insights.quote: Sumi test +60.39 pp、Sumi OOD +57.17 ppです。
insights.locator: 日本語PIIモデルの追加学習で確認された性能向上

insights.claim: On Sumi OOD (520 documents of Wikipedia, legal and literary text with embedded synthetic PII), the fine-tuned GLiNER model scored 65.30% micro F1 versus 8.13% for the base, with precision/recall of 61.63%/69.43% (vs 85.17%/65.10% on Sumi test).
insights.speaker: Masaya Ogushi
insights.so_what: Out-of-template generalization lags in-template results and recall stays mid-60s, leaving room for commercial PII products.
insights.quote: Sumi OOD（520文書）は、Wikipedia・法令・文学の文章に合成PIIを埋め込み、テンプレート外への汎化を評価するデータです。
insights.locator: 日本語PIIモデルの追加学習で確認された性能向上

insights.claim: Internal validation F1 peaked at 98.08% after epoch 1 (97.53% at epochs 2 and 3), but the authors treat it only as a checkpoint-selection metric because documents within the dataset are highly similar.
insights.speaker: Masaya Ogushi
insights.so_what: Near-perfect in-distribution scores overstate real capability; investors should discount headline validation numbers on synthetic data.
insights.quote: 文書間の類似性が高いため、内部検証F1はチェックポイント選択のための指標とし
insights.locator: 日本語PIIモデルの追加学習で確認された性能向上

insights.claim: Annotations in Nemotron PII Japan follow per-document-type rules and may not cover all PII in the text, so scoring unannotated spans as non-PII can count correct detections as false positives; and since all 100,000 documents contain PII, false-positive rates on PII-free documents require separate evaluation data.
insights.speaker: Masaya Ogushi
insights.so_what: Benchmark precision/F1 claims built on this dataset need caveats before being used in vendor comparisons.
insights.quote: 未注釈箇所を非PIIとして採点すると、正しい検出も誤検知として数えられる場合があるため、適合率やF1の解釈には注意が必要です。
insights.locator: 実用的な AI アプリケーションへの利用

insights.claim: The dataset targets engineers building Japanese PII detection and masking, AI-safety researchers and security staff, and teams designing document sharing/analytics platforms, with use cases such as masking before sending to external LLMs, PII removal before summarizing inquiry logs, and pre-sharing review of logs and reports; the authors advise re-evaluating on target data before production.
insights.speaker: Masaya Ogushi
insights.so_what: Defines the buyer set for Japanese AI-governance tooling: regulated enterprises and their SIs.
insights.quote: 本番導入前には適用先のデータと運用条件で再評価します。
